description: A white paper sheet sits on a pink bed surface in front of both hands, with a pale fabric backdrop behind it. The right hand moves in from the right to pinch and gather the paper while the left hand comes in from the left to help, briefly making the paper a two-hand object as it’s crumpled into a ball; then both hands pull outward to open it and press down, sliding and smoothing to flatten the paper against the bed so it becomes a two-hand object being spread and patted flat.
